fields.ht_src: origin of the half-time score: MATCHHISTORY (warehouse, exact date+team ids) or BSD_EVENT (provider event, exact event id or exact provider team ids + identical full-time score); null when none
fields.opp_identity: UNRESOLVED_PROVIDER_NAME / UNRESOLVED when opp is a bsdext_<id> label
fields.opp_name: provider name of an opponent that has no registry team id (exact id match in the same provider pages; present only for such rows)
fields.opp_ppg10: opponent's points per match over its ten matches before that game (strength proxy, no rating)
fields.poss_f: own ball possession in percent (supplementary source only; null when no source holds it)
fields.proc_src: provenance of supplementary process values filled into this row, e.g. 'sf:FBREF,xgf:API_FOOTBALL'; null when every value comes from the warehouse / football-data
fields.rest: days since this team's previous match

labels.missing: null / n=0 = the source rows hold no value (NOT_AVAILABLE), nothing is estimated
labels.origin: DERIVED from the original rows of this block; ORIGINAL values are the rows themselves

workload.basis: DERIVED from the rows of this block; strictly before the cut-off day
